subject: Re: POC Wrap — Solstice metrics + reference/testimonial?
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@solstice-fin.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: POC complete — preliminary metrics attached

Hi Priyom and team,

Great work on the pilot — the internal stakeholders and engineering team are really happy with how the integration went. Quick summary of the metrics we tracked during the 2-week pilot (attached):

- Average inference latency (95th pct): 210ms (was ~420ms on our prior host)
- Cost per 1k tokens (approx): $1.05 (projected savings ~38%)
- Error rate (timeouts/invalid responses): <0.5%
- Uptime observed: 99.95%

We ran the end-to-end flow against production-like traffic for three days and validated quality on our benchmark prompts. The attached poc-results-summary.pdf has the full charts and a short quote from our engineering lead.

We're planning an internal "wrap" next Wednesday with the product and procurement teams. Before that, marketing asked whether Solstice would be open to serving as a reference — a short quote and permission to share the results in a case study/case blurb would be hugely helpful.

Happy to jump on a 15-minute call if you want to walk through the numbers live.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Data & AI, Solstice Finance
elena@solstice-fin.com
--Attachment: poc-results-summary.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

Hi Elena — thank you, and huge congrats to your team. This is exactly the kind of outcome we strive for.

Would Solstice be comfortable with two quick things?
1) A one-sentence customer quote we can use in a short case blurb (we can draft and you can edit)
2) Permission to include the high-level metrics you shared (latency, cost reduction, uptime) and Solstice logo in a public case study.

If you're open to it, we can do a 15-minute call this week to draft language together. If easier, I've included a proposed quote below you can edit: 

"Redwood Inference cut our inference latency in half while reducing per-token cost by nearly 40% — the integration was seamless and the performance gains showed immediately."

If you'd rather send something short in email, that'll work too. I'm copying Marissa (Customer Success) and Aditya (Sales Lead) so we can lock down logistics quickly.

Thanks again — proud of what your team accomplished here.

Best,
